text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for summer camp, and tons of fans have surrounded the bus that will take us there, but Kitasan Black isn't letting it go to her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Being voted as the most popular Umamusume is proof that people have high expectations of her. She swears to live up to them this summer.
